1101.name: Scorchclaw Pup
1101.description:
Jungle Companions
Summon a Scorchclaw that assists you against monsters.

The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and periodically imbues your next Attack or Ability to burn enemies and Slow them. Killing large monsters readies this immediately.

1102.name: Gustwalker Hatchling
1102.description:
Jungle Companions
Summon a Gustwalker that assists you against monsters.

The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and grants Move Speed upon entering brush, increased when killing large monsters.

1103.name: Mosstomper Seedling
1103.description:
Jungle Companions
Summon a Mosstomper that assists you against monsters.

The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and grants a Shield while out of combat and after killing large monsters.

entries.item_1101_tooltipextended:
Jungle Companions
Summon a Scorchclaw who deals @spell.SummonerSmite:PetDPS@ damage, heals you for @spell.SummonerSmite:PetHPS@ per second, makes you deal @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:DamageAmp*100@% damage and take @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:MonsterDamageTaken*100@% damage against monsters.

Scorchclaw's Slash
The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it periodically imbues your next Attack or Ability to burn enemies for @AvatarMaxHPBurnTotal*100@% max health true damage over @AvatarBurnDuration@ seconds and Slow them by @AvatarSlowAmount*100@%, decaying over @AvatarSlowDuration@ seconds. Killing large monsters readies this immediately.
  • The companion can be fed up to @TotalCounters@ Treats. When you kill a large monster you feed it once, twice if you have bonus treats. You periodically get bonus treats to feed to your companion which also grant bonus gold.
  • @Breakpoint1@ Treats: Your Smite deals @spell.SummonerSmite:SmiteUpgradedDamage@ damage. It can be cast on enemy champions to deal reduced damage and Slow them.
  • @TotalCounters@ Treats: Your Smite deals @spell.SummonerSmite:Smite2ndUpgradedDamage@ damage to nearby monsters.

    Gain an additional @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:TreatXP@ experience per large or epic monster killed and @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:FirstMonsterBonusXP@ additional experience from the first.
    Killing a large or epic monster restores up to @spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:MinHealTooltip@-@spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:BaseHealCap@ Health and @spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:MinManaTooltip@-@spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:MaxManaTooltip@ Mana.
